## What this assignment will cover

- Describe the unique characteristics of the STL set (unique values, sorted order).
- Identify the time complexity of set and map operations.
- Explain the behavior of an iterator.
- Describe the unique characteristics of the STL map (key-value pairs, unique keys).
- Reason about the unique behavior of indexing ([]) in a map.

## Course skills

Primary practice for skills **G1, G2**. See
